property_summary: For any caller and any block.timestamp, a direct payable low-level call to the contract's fallback with exactly 10 ether will revert on the reference C whenever block.timestamp <= pastBlockTime, but the mutant may succeed in that situation (so the reference always prevents non-increasing timestamps while the mutant can accept them).
change_summary: Remove the timestamp ordering require so calls with non-increasing timestamps no longer revert.
